title: AbCellera to Report First Quarter 2026 Financial Results on May 11, 2026
summary: AbCellera (Nasdaq: ABCL) will announce its first quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, May 11, 2026, and hold an earnings conference call at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (5:00 p.m. Eastern Time) the same day. A live audio webcast of the earnings conference may be accessed through a link that will be posted on AbCellera’s Investor Relations website . A replay will be available through the same link following the conference call. About AbCellera Biologics Inc. AbCellera (Nasdaq: ABCL) is a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on discovering and developing first-in-class antibody-based medicines in the areas of endocrinology, women’s health, immunology, oncology, and more. For more information, please visit www.abcellera.com .
